title: 1.1 Titlekarte Tee
description: Drop: Normformate. Edition of 20. Released Tuesday 13.12.22. Orange screened tag. Front: Two color screen print, custom mixed blue, slight puff black. Normformate custom lettering by [Todd Rupp](https://myspace.com/trupp666). Font used is Lostgun by [Qatatype](https://qaratype.com/). Back: Oversize 19" screen print, black ink. A-size paper format logo used and created by [Walter Porstmann](https://monoskop.org/Walter_Porstmann) in 1922.

title: 1.2 Titlekarte Tee
description: Drop: Athletik. Edition of 20. Released Sunday 16.3.23. Dark purple screened tag. Front: Two color DTG print. Discus thrower from a Soviet era olympic postcard also featuring the roof netting of the [Olympiastadion](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Olympiastadion_(Munich)) in Munich built for the 1972 Olympics. Font used is [David by Emilie Rigaud](https://aisforfonts.com/david) and published through A is for -- Fonts. Also used; Pixelator by [Evlogiev Studio](https://creativemarket.com/EvlogievStudio).

title: 2.1 Notgeld Tee
description: Drop: Normformate. Edition of 20. Released Tuesday 13.12.22. Orange screened tag. Front: One color, double flashed, left chest, custom mixed tan. [Scharfes S](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/%C3%9F) by [Todd Rupp](https://www.discogs.com/artist/3546778-Todd-Rupp), font used Ekeras W01 Regular by [Type Innovations](http://luc.devroye.org/showcase-alexkaczun/). Back: Three color 18" back print, custom blue and tan with black ink. Double flashed tan and blue for lasting print. Notgeld design created November 14, 1921 for the town of [Papenburg](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Papenburg). There is an almost identical 75 note. Original German statement translated as: 'The money must taken from the people, you can't shake it from the trees.'

title: 2.2 Notgeld Tee
description: Drop: Athletik. Edition of 20. Released Sunday 16.3.23. Dark purple screened tag. Front: One color screen print left chest. Font used is [Cool Font](https://hvnter.net/products/p/coolfont-volume-1) by Hvnter. Back: Two color oversize 18" print, custom gold Wilflex ink from the early 00's. Double flashed gold. Notgeld design created for the 'Berliner Sport-Club' in 1922. These notes, often referred to as Bausteine (or 'brick'), represent a donation to help build a Sportplatz for the [Berliner Sport-Club](https://www.berlinersportclub.de/), which still exists today under the same name.
